description: AeroTech E18W ascent + E18W landing (RMS-24/40, plugged), 1.4 kg at liftoff; the recommended setup from motor-chute-study-2026-11-04 (legs on at ignition confirm, 0.75 s band cut, spent ascent casing pushed out at landing ignition, 1.4 m / 55 in annular chute, Cd 2.2 -> CdA 3.39 m^2, 2.55 m/s steady; the sim's plain 0.4 s inflation ramp, not the study's fill model).
